g.text: from a codebase you inherited to reviewed, evidence-cited claims
git is a scoped bulk pass; Jira and the wiki are
fetched only by keys discovered from the code
local Ollama index; symbols → feature areas
checked mechanically before any model judges
accept / edit / reject — edits land in the YAML
flags claims whose cited code drifted
every LLM stage reports its own cost · nothing is written outside claims/ and evidence.db
re-running is manual today — the forward
pipeline (P2) does this per merged PR
